classdef.name: AutoSizingTypeEnum
classdef.shortdesc: Auto sizing type options for text.

property.name: HEIGHT_ONLY
property.shortdesc: Text frame will be resized in height dimension only.

property.name: WIDTH_ONLY
property.shortdesc: Text frame will be resized in width dimension only.

property.name: HEIGHT_AND_WIDTH
property.shortdesc: Text frame will be resized in both(height and width) dimensions.

property.name: HEIGHT_AND_WIDTH_PROPORTIONALLY
property.shortdesc: Text frame will be resized in both(height and width) dimensions proportionally.
